paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 5.5, with a 2.04% increase from the prior close and a 27.63% decrease over 22 sessions. The price is as of September 11, 2026.

Recent news headlines feature the company's potential tenant deal and its impact on the stock, as well as the launch of a $350 million convertible notes offering. An investor group owning about 22% of Fermi has proposed hiring an independent bank to weigh sale or recap options. The news articles are from sources including Stocktwits and Stock Titan, and were published on September 12 and 11, 2026.

There have been 25 total SEC filings, including 3 Form 4 filings and 7 proxy solicitation filings. Recent filings include a Form PX14A6G on September 11, 2026, and a Form 8-K on August 31, 2026, which announced the scheduling of the company's first annual meeting of stockholders. Insider transaction reports were also filed on August 27 and 18, 2026.
